notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block or kill Satya.
description:
Declare Aurelia and Satya as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Satya trigger, creating a token copy of Long River Lurker and causing you to get {E}{E}.
When the Long River Lurker token enters, it triggers, targeting Aurelia.
Resolve the Aurelia trigger from step 1, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using Aurelia, triggering the Long River Lurker token, blinking Aurelia.
Repeat each combat phase.
